English: Totem Glade
Wooden totems and carved figures mark a sheltered glade, drawing merchants and marketfolk for periodic trade fairs.
Stone Circle
Rough, upright stones form a circle, attracting traders, craftsmen, and travelers alike.
Shrine Clearing
A simple, cleared patch of earth at the citys edge, used for gatherings and minor market stalls.
Ritual Hearth
A large, stone-lined hearth surrounded by timber benches, serving as a focal point for civic gatherings and local council meetings.
Ancestral Oak
A massive, ancient oak dominates the grove, surrounded by paved paths, market booths, and council huts.
Sacred Pool
A spring-fed pool encircled by carved stones and wooden platforms, bustling with traders and city folk.
Druidic Grove
A cultivated grove with stone benches, market pavilions, and administrative huts, serving as the citys civic heart.
Spirit Thicket
Thick groves, hidden pathways, and ornate market halls provide security, trade, and city governance.
Hidden Sanctuary
A secluded urban park ringed with stone walls and guarded entrances, this sanctuary houses city treasuries and special markets.
Great Grove
A vast, walled, and cultivated urban woodland, home to bustling trade, city administration, and a powerful seat of civic authority.
